topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Holography and Diffraction

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Wave Nature of Light
lecture_lines: Light acts as an electromagnetic wave.
Waves possess both amplitude and phase.
Constructive interference adds peak to peak.
animations: Create a central light source emitting wave ripples.
Fade in a barrier showing wave propagation patterns.
Highlight interference fringes appearing on a screen.
Color the light source to indicate coherent wave frequency.
Morph ripples into a standard wavefront representation.

sections.title: Understanding Diffraction
lecture_lines: Diffraction is waves bending around obstacles.
Objects transform waves into spatial patterns.
Fourier transforms map these spatial frequencies.
animations: Show two beams meeting at a point.
Animate interference pattern expansion with #FF00FF light.
Show barrier edges causing wave bending animations.
Display intensity plot update with bright #00FFFF lines.
Label the diffraction angle with #FFFFFF math text.

sections.title: The Holography Mechanism: Recording
lecture_lines: Object beams reflect off the subject.
Interference freezes phase data on film.
animations: Illustrate object beam and reference beam geometry.
Animate beam convergence on a photographic plate.
Show interference fringe pattern forming on the plate.

sections.title: The Holography Mechanism: Reconstruction
lecture_lines: The hologram acts like a key.
animations: Show reference beam striking the recorded hologram.
Animate reconstruction of the virtual object wave.
Display the reconstructed image appearing behind the hologram.
